provenanceNote: Re-recorded against the head that carries the review fixes. The first version of this file named b6ea356 with 148 unit and 45 e2e — a commit that still contained both bugs review found (invented open-circuit bounds, and document-level shortcuts swallowing radio arrow keys). Evidence that validates a superseded commit asserts nothing about what merges, so it was regenerated rather than patched. Runs were made against a clean working tree at the commit above; only the commit adding this file follows it.

reviewFixesCovered.openCircuitBounds: Ported from src/state.js: gsAdjustO2 gives 0 to 1-He, gsAdjustPressure gives 200-300 bar. The earlier 0.05 and 50 were invented, and the unit tests had codified them. Two tests now assert the bounds against the named legacy functions.
reviewFixesCovered.keyboardOwnership: The document-level handler declines any key the focused control owns: arrows on a radio, Enter and Space on a button. Focus is also restored after the re-render, which it was not before.
reviewFixesCovered.regressionTestsVerifiedAgainstUnfixedCod: With the guard disabled, 'mode and site can be chosen with the keyboard alone' and 'a focused control survives the re-render' both fail; with it, both pass.

releaseLabel.supersededReasoning: 'nothing under src/ changes' — false: deploy.yml runs `pages deploy src/` with no ignore file, and this PR changes seven files under src/app/.
releaseLabel.actualReasoning: Deployed bytes do change, but no served behaviour does. src/_redirects sends / to diving-simulator.html, so a visitor gets the legacy client; the migration client is uploaded and not reachable until the #170 cutover. Cutting a minor release for a feature no user can run would version the repository rather than the product.
